pose: A solitary, vertical sea stack, resembling a smoothed, unadorned clay pillar. The form is minimalist with all hard edges rounded, standing vertically to fill the central column of the card.

environmental_details.ground: The pillar itself is deep, rich Terracotta and Brick Red claystone, completely free of any vegetation or cracks.
environmental_details.atmosphere: The base is surrounded by a low, soft layer of pale morning mist over the river.
